name: gizza-ai/heatmap-chart
summary: Render a numeric grid as an SVG heatmap.

tool.description: Render a numeric matrix/grid as a color-coded SVG heatmap with a sequential blue→yellow→red colormap, an optional value in each cell, row/column labels, and a min→max color legend. `data` is rows of comma/space-separated numbers (one row per line, all rows equal width). Set show_values=false to hide cell numbers; col_labels/row_labels optionally name the axes.

data.description: The grid: rows of comma/space-separated numbers (one row per line). All rows must have the same number of columns.

show_values.description: Print each cell's numeric value inside the cell. Default true.

col_labels.description: Optional comma-separated column headings (defaults to c1..cN).

row_labels.description: Optional comma-separated row headings (defaults to r1..rN).
